entities.name: Bartolomeu Dias
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Portuguese navigator (c. 1450–1500) who in 1488 became the first European to sail around the southern tip of Africa, which he named the Cape of Storms (renamed Cape of Good Hope by King John II). His achievement proved a sea route to India was possible, directly enabling Vasco da Gama's voyage a decade later.
entities.died: 1500, off the Cape of Good Hope (shipwreck)
